title.th: คำสั่งค่าธรรมเนียม (กระทรวงสิ่งแวดล้อม)

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Ministry of the Environment) Order.

2. There shall be payable at the office of the Ministry of the Environment the following fees:
(a)for every application for information involving search and examination of records not relating to any premises
$7
(b)for every application for information involving search and examination of records relating to any premises, in respect of each premises
$7
(c)for a certified copy of any official record
$7.
[G.N. Nos. S 121/95; S150/2001]
